name: yuri
description: YURI-OS-specific scanners (organs, registries, memory_schema, formula_banks) — optional pack, NOT part of the neutral core.
note: Registry auto-discovery loads scanners/ (core) only. Packs are opt-in by design: load via the --packs yuri CLI flag or the config packs section. Pack scanners use absolute imports (from scanners.base import ...) since they do not live inside the core scanners package.
